meta.timezone_notes: Venue Los Angeles = PDT (UTC-7) until 01/11/2026 02:00, then PST (UTC-8). NZ = NZDT (UTC+13) all event long. PDT->NZDT = +20h; PST->NZDT = +21h. Allen TX = CDT (UTC-5) until 01/11 then CST (UTC-6). Brooklyn = EDT/EST (final 14/11 = EST, UTC-5, NZDT +18h).

swiss.venue: Credit Union of Texas (CUTX) Event Center, Allen, Texas (~8,100-8,600)
swiss.rules: Up to 5 rounds. Teams with identical records are paired each round. 3 wins = advance, 3 losses = eliminated. Bo1 normally; Bo3 when a team can qualify or be eliminated. No rematches. Same-region matchups barred in Round 1 only, allowed from Round 2. 8 teams advance.

r1_tiers.verification: CONFIRMED identical to claim. First-party: Riot primer lists Tier 1-4 exactly as claimed. Seed-origin mapping from Sheep Esports rulebook summary. Insider Gaming, Inven, AccountShark agree.
r1_tiers.round1_pairing: Tier 1 vs Tier 4; Tier 2 vs Tier 3; random draw; no same-region pairing.
r1_tiers.derived_region_constraints_for_r1: (Derived by reading the tiers, not quoted) GEN cannot draw DK; AL cannot draw IG; HLE cannot draw T1; BLG cannot draw TES. Play-In winner: if KC then not G2; if C9 then not TLAW; if MVK or FURIA, no Tier-1 conflict.

swiss.r1_draw_note: NOT published. Round 1 draw is scheduled for 18/10/2026 (US date, after the Play-In winner is known); pots are published, pairings are not.
swiss.later_draws: Per Inven: draws occur 23/10, 24/10, 26/10, 30/10 (rounds 2-5). Exact round-to-day mapping UNKNOWN.
